subject: general
question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

The carpenter replaced the broken ________ in the window.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pane**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**pane**" refers to a single sheet of glass in a window or door. (कांच का शीशा)
 
• The sentence implies that the carpenter replaced a broken glass sheet in the window.
 
• The other options: "**plain**," "**peyn**," and "**pain**" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The carpenter replaced the broken pane__ in the window.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Plain (सादा)**: means simple or unadorned.
 
• **Peyn**: is not a valid word in English.
 
• **Pain (दर्द)**: means physical or emotional suffering.
